title: How Chronic Constipation Alters Vagal Tone and Triggers Nocturnal ST-Segment Variability in Adults 61+ With Known Vasovagal Syncope History
description: Details the gut-brain-heart axis in older adults — linking colonic distension, vagal hyperactivity, and transient ischemic-like ECG changes during sleep.

title: Does Daily Tart Cherry Juice *Really* Reduce Endothelial Microparticle Release in Adults 70+ With Stage 1 Hypertension and Mild Hyperuricemia?
description: Evaluates clinical trial data on anthocyanin-rich tart cherry interventions — focusing on endothelial-derived microparticles (CD31+/CD42b−), uric acid interaction, and dosing precision.
